title: Identity
description: Shared identity fields used by both definitions and instances. The host schemas (definition.schema, instance.schema) enforce per-half required-ness; this file defines the field types.

id.description: Unique within origin scope. snake_case. Stable across edits.

name.description: Human-readable label. Required on definitions; optional on instances (defaults to '<definition.name> #<n>').

description.description: One-to-three sentence prose summary. Required on definitions; optional on instances (defaults to definition's description).

kind.description: What kind of thing this is. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §4 kind taxonomy + active_variable (per §13). Appears on definitions and AV registry entries.

kind_ref.description: Same enum as 'kind' but appears on instances, indicating the kind of the definition the instance points at.

origin.description: Where this object came from. Per OBJECT-MODEL.md §5.
